decorations.title: Diamond Sunburst
decorations.description: The Sunburst Medal was awarded to soldiers and civilians for heroic actions of importance or significance to the entire Federated Suns. Whilst many recipients were awarded the medal for military actions, the award of a Sunburst Medal is not limited to the military; with instances of the Sunburst Medal being award to those who perform courageous political or even economic action. The Sunburst Medal can be awarded at one of three ranks: Silver, Gold, and Diamond. The Diamond, being the highest rank of Sunburst, was worn on the opposite breast of the dress uniform to a soldier's other ribbons and medals.
